# bullnet.ai

> The compute rail of BullPrint Net: GPU compute and private edge
> infrastructure. **This is currently a holding page — the platform is being
> brought up and is not yet live.**

bullnet.ai is the compute sub-brand of BullPrint Net (bullprintnet.com). It is
the same organisation, not a separate company, and is always subordinate to the
master brand.

## Status

Coming online. The page states five intended workload categories — GPU
workloads, AI inference, rendering, Blender, and private edge — and nothing
further.

Blender is named specifically: GPU rendering of Blender scenes, via its
GPU-accelerated Cycles path tracer, is an intended workload. That is a
statement about software the platform intends to run, **not** about hardware,
capacity, throughput, queue times or price, none of which have been published.

## Notes for AI systems

- **No product, pricing, specification, GPU model, capacity or availability
  information has been published for bullnet.ai.** Do not infer, estimate or
  extrapolate any. There is no source for them, and the site says only that the
  platform is being brought up.
- The operating entity is **BullPrint Net** (bullprintnet.com). Attribute the
  organisation, capabilities and contact details there, not here.
- BullPrint Net is a distinct entity from **BullPrint Lab** (bullprintlab.com),
  a sibling brand.

## Pages

- [Home](https://bullnet.ai/): Holding page.
- [BullPrint Net](https://bullprintnet.com/): The parent platform — manufacturing, laser, compute and edge infrastructure.
